title: Ankhorage Graph Database
summary: Records the repository boundary reserved for a provider-neutral graph database port.
purpose: Keep ownership of graph persistence contracts distinct from generic in-memory graph algorithms and provider adapters.
responsibilities: Own the repository-level boundary for a standalone graph database port when it is released.
boundaries: Does not currently publish a graph database package or runtime implementation.
Does not own generic in-memory graph algorithms or concrete provider clients.
audience: Maintainers defining or consuming a future provider-neutral graph persistence boundary.

architecture.role: Non-source contract repository with no published port on the current default branch.
invariants: A future port remains provider-neutral and concrete graph databases remain in separate adapters.

limitations: The current default branch contains licensing and repository metadata only; no graph database API is shipped.
